description: Read where one send_feedback message stands: pending (waiting for a person to review it), approved (passed on to the Autoview team) or declined (reviewed and not passed on), with received_at. Pass the id send_feedback returned and the same account token it was sent with. Only the status comes back, never the message or contact. Feedback sent without a token has no status to read. Returns { id, status, received_at, note }. A refusal returns { error, code, fix }: bad_id, not_found (no such id for this account; the same answer for an id that belongs to someone else), invalid_token, feedback_unavailable. Do what fix says.

id.description: the id send_feedback returned (a UUID such as 01a1c64b-0000-7000-8000-000000000000)

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured). Use the token the feedback was sent with.

name: feedback_status
